world: env_flight v1: follow a given 3-D route in hidden wind; no-fly safety guard
reward: progress 0.1/m, cross-track -0.04/m -0.004/m2, speed error, smoothness; reached +20; crash -30; guard -1/step
curriculum: wind level +0.2 when >=80 % reached and x-track < 3 m
outcome: full wind, 100 % reached, 0.72 m mean cross-track, 0 % crash (12-flight tests); beat PID (90 %, 1.38 m, 10 % crash)
ended_why: user: no route may be given (all behaviour RL) -> replaced by drone navigation

world: env_mission v1: one pod zone, rule pod round, 4 drones, quick flight stand-in
reward: delivery +10 - 0.004*lead; crash -40 (only at decisions); queue -0.002/order/decision
outcome: 19-24 deliveries/h vs rule 11.5, but 7.6-13.7 crashes/100 vs rule 4.2
ended_why: audit: crashes while hovering/chasing were free; crash too cheap -> v2 rewards

world: env_mission v2
reward: crash -150 everywhere; landing < 20 % battery -2 per %
outcome: ~13-19 deliveries/h, 0-6 crashes/100 (rule 11.5 / 4.2), lead ~4-5 min (rule 15.5 min)

world: env_nav v1: one leg to the drop, solid buildings/trees (2 m height map), pure RL
reward: progress 0.05/m (new best only), time -0.01, closeness < 3 m cost, crash -50, reached +50
curriculum: dist 200 -> +150 to 900 at >=70 % reached, then wind
outcome: 0 % reached; climbed to ~1,770 m until the battery died
ended_why: reward hack: climbing avoids every obstacle

world: env_nav v2: + 150 m ceiling (failure), height cost, battery running cost
reward: v1 + ceiling -50, height > 60 m cost, battery -0.02/% drained
outcome: 12 % crash, 0 % reached, 88 % hovered until the time limit
ended_why: reward hack: hover safely until time-out

world: env_nav v3: time-out = failure
reward: v2 + time-out -50
outcome: 0 % reached at 200 m trips; seen circling the drop in watch mode
ended_why: weak progress signal; short trips needed

world: env_nav v4
reward: potential-based closeness (0.3/m + 25*exp(-d/15)), circling cost 0.02*tangential speed, reached +100
curriculum: dist 80 -> +60 to 200 -> +150 to 900 at >=70 %, then wind
outcome: 69 % reached on 140 m trips
ended_why: user: drones must also fly to the meeting point and land on the pod (two legs)

world: env_nav v5: drop hover (+60) then land on the pod at a meeting point (+100); leg flag in observation; 480 s
reward: v4 per leg; pod crash -50
outcome: 41 % fallback-trip bug fixed 11-10 10:2x; landing rule loosened 11-10 11:4x; at 6.3 M steps: 200 m trips, 88 % delivered, 69 % landed; best at 24 M (step_023992572): 900 m trips, 69 % delivered, 50 % landed
ended_why: 8 h allocation ended; continued as nav_v6 with a changed reward

world: env_nav v6 (Google Antigravity, 11-11): phase-1 goal height on a fixed cone (cruise +40 m, linear descent inside 25 m); landing also needs tilt <= 12 deg
reward: progress only for beating the best distance so far (0.3/m); time-out -100 (was -50)
curriculum: as v5 to 900 m; pinned at 150 m from 11-11 15:46 (--dist)
outcome: policy collapse: landed 50 % -> 6 % by 30 M, 0 % from ~36 M; the action stopped depending on the observation (probe std 0.50 at 24 M, 0.003 at 99.7 M) and log_std fell -1 -> -6; the brain creeps at ~1 m/s into the first building or drifts until the battery is flat
ended_why: nobody acted on 0 % landed for ~55 M steps; diagnosed 2026-11-13 (docs/NAV_FIX_BRIEF.md)

algorithm: RecurrentPPO from step_023992572 (24 M), ent_coef 0.005, log_std floor -2.0
world: env_nav v7: v6 without the goal-height cone (goal = pod roof); tilt rule and time-out -100 kept
reward: potential-based progress again (phi = -0.3 d + 25 exp(-d/15), the v5 reward)
curriculum: from 300 m (--dist), +150 m at >= 70 % landed and no alarm, to 900 m, then wind
outcome: see progress; new KPI + health columns and auto-stop alarms (docs/RL_DELIVERY.md section 13)
